article.title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required

harvestedTerms.summary: NVIDIA Kumo Relational is a pre-trained foundation model for relational database prediction — a 'structured data foundation model' that replaces task-specific ML pipelines with in-context learning on raw relational graphs. The article introduces several trackable concepts: relational foundation models, a Predictive Query Language (PQL), and the broader paradigm shift from supervised pipelines to structured-data foundation models. These are novel enough to warrant longlist candidates.

mustReadFlagged.reason: A rare concrete instantiation of the 'foundation model paradigm shift' argument — applied not to language or vision but to enterprise relational databases. The Kumo Relational paper makes a genuinely testable claim (few-shot beats supervised ML on relational benchmarks) and introduces a new model category worth following as the structured-data AI space matures.

article.title: Southeast Asia’s digital economy to hit $368 billion

harvestedTerms.summary: Google's 11th e-Conomy SEA report frames Southeast Asia's digital economy growth through the lens of generative AI adoption, projecting $1 trillion by 2035. The article introduces 'agentic commerce' as a consumer-trust-driven next phase, uses 'tokens' as an economic benchmark, and highlights data infrastructure and regional trade policy as enabling conditions. Limited terminological novelty but strong on framing terms around AI adoption at scale.

article.title: Today’s PHP Security Release, and How We’re Strengthening PHP Security

harvestedTerms.summary: Simon Willison links to a PHP security incident where a coordinated disclosure process failed — CVE details leaked early, triggering accelerated exploit development. Notable detail: the original vulnerability was discovered by Wiz Research using AI tools including Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol. The post is a brief link-blog entry with a short summary of the disclosure timeline.
